claim: cash advances and billing across the lifecycle

checks.name: owner sees the issue-invoice form
issueInvoice creates an invoice
the invoice total is quantity x unit rate
the currency is stored upper-cased
a new invoice starts in status 'issued'
issueInvoice writes exactly one line item
the line amount matches the invoice total
issueInvoice writes an audit row
the invoice detail page shows the payment form
a partial payment moves the invoice to 'partially_paid'
exactly one payment row exists
a date-only 'paid on' round-trips to the same calendar day
settling the balance moves the invoice to 'paid'
the payment form is hidden once the invoice is fully paid
employee sees the cash advance request form
createCashAdvanceRequest writes a request
submitting the request opened an approval workflow
a new request starts at 'hr_review'
the remaining balance starts equal to the amount requested
HR sees the request in the review queue
an Approve control is offered on that row
the confirmation dialog opens
no unhandled error is shown to HR
the approval engine recorded an action
reviewCashAdvance advances the request out of hr_review
the advanced status is one the workflow defines
the approval workflow wrote request rows
a second request exists to be rejected
HR sees the rejection candidate in the queue
a Reject control is offered on that row
rejecting asks for confirmation that names the consequence
checks.detail: Reject cash advance? This request will be marked rejected. Cancel Reject

checks.name: reviewCashAdvance('reject') moves the request to rejected
the approval engine recorded the rejection, not an approval
no unexpected console errors
no page errors
invoice table is back to its starting size
invoice items are back to their starting size
invoice payments are back to their starting size
cash advance requests are back to their starting size

notes: paid_at is type=date, so the value is a bare YYYY-MM-DD parsed as UTC midnight, which stays on the same day for hosts between UTC-12 and UTC+11. This is the shape the NTE deadline got WRONG: that field carried a time component.
Cash advance approval produced 'finance_review'. advanceApprovalRequest decides whether the two-step workflow completes; the run asserts the status it produced rather than assuming 'approved'.
